bio: Soak up a beautiful scenic view while enjoying Afternoon Tea at Aldwyn’s at Ellerslie, a contemporary bistro in acres of idyllic countryside.  The glorious location is set inside a grade II-listed building in the heart of Malvern, with chic yet kitsch decor - think warm autumnal tones of mauve and berry, comfortable sofas in eclectic prints and large windows bathing the interior in light.  Start with a range of traditional finger sandwiches, followed by delicious scones and freshly-baked pastries and desserts. Why not add Prosecco, cocktails or a G&T to your package for some extra decadence?  While inside Aldwyn’s at Ellerslie feels like an oasis of calm, it's actually just a short drive away from Great Malvern Rail Station.  On your visit your Afternoon Tea may be presented a little differently to the images displayed. The venue vary their selection of sweet treats according to seasonality and adapt their offering so that regular guests can look forward to something new each time. They also theme their Afternoon Tea from time to time, so your experience will feel a little more exclusive during events such as Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day, Easter, Father’s Day, Halloween and Christmas.  A lighter Cream Tea option is available should you prefer, and  Vegan and Gluten-free dietary requirements can also be catered for. The venue politely ask that all Afternoon Tea bookings are placed in advance and that any special requests are made at the time of booking, to ensure they can provide the best possible experience on the day.
